summary: Load Shape Lab Iteration 2 (cafe chain portfolio + multi-meter aggregation + appliance decomposition) fully validated. All 14 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend dashboard loads 10 cafe meters across VIC/NSW/QLD/SA, single + aggregate views work, appliance-decomposed curve renders with TOU bands + 3 draggable shift blocks, drag in aggregate mode produces chain-wide savings, reset works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: agg_zone uses max() on a set with a tie-breaker key — for equal frequencies the choice depends on set iteration order; consider using Counter.most_common(1) for determinism (minor).
seed_data.py: shifted_shape recomputes meter_appliances + meter_baseline_shape per call; for aggregate-of-10 + 12 plans this is fine (40ms), but if portfolio grows, cache per-meter baselines.
All endpoints validate input via Pydantic; meter_ids has min_length=1 enforcing 422 on empty — good.
_id from MongoDB is not exposed because no Mongo reads are performed in /api/rank or /api/meters — clean.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 14/14 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_loadshapelab_api.py pass. Validated: 10 cafe meters across 4 states, 8-appliance decomposition with sum == baseline_shape invariant, 3 shiftable assets (hvac/dishwasher/hot-water), new RankRequest contract {meter_ids, asset_positions, active_assets}, aggregate-of-10 ~10x single-site cost, shift propagation across chain. Frontend: Brunswick East default selection, all data-testids present (meter-card-MTR-001..010, select-all-btn, reset-all-btn, aggregation-banner, all stat-* IDs, shift-block-{hvac|dishwasher|hot-water}, meter-rail, shift-library, plan-strip, load-canvas-svg). Verified: Aggregate-all-sites flips header to 'Aggregated · 10 sites · 233.6 MWh/yr', stat-strip jumps to $72,339 spend / $12,872 saving, banner lists all 10 sites; shift+click MTR-003 adds to selection (banner remains visible); dragging dishwasher block ~500px left in aggregate mode reduced spend by $2,310 (well above the $1,000 chain-wide expectation, confirming ~10x amplification); reset-shifts button restored $72,339 spend with '0 blocks moved' indicator. Client-side optimistic chart updates work as designed (chart redrew immediately on drag).
